name: Jar
material: Glazed stoneware with resist and slip-painted decoration, Jizhou ware
dimensions: Diameter: 13.4 cm (5 1/4 in.); Overall: 11.3 cm (4 7/16 in.)
summary: Like the Teabowl with Tortoiseshell Glaze (CMA 2020.177), this jar was made in the Jizhou kilns of southeast China. Producing a variety of innovative dark glaze types, the potter here created a dynamic abstract pattern of waves in the form of light brown strokes brushed over a dark brown glaze.
